title: These Are The Only 20 Tools You Need.
description:
ChatGPT is dead. Here are the 20 AI tools that replaced it.

I run an AI agency. I tested every tool with my team worth testing this year and twenty made the cut. Some will print money for you. Some are massively overhyped. One I haven't even touched but my team vouched for it.

I've prepared a detailed guide on everything that is useful by the beginning of May 2026: every tool ranked, my honest verdict, and exactly how to use each one in your business.

Comment 'List' below and I'll DM you the AI tools.
transcript: Gold will make you rich in general. ChatGPT used to be good, but now it's garbage. Gemini is good for facts, maths, and business calculations. Grok, I'm disappointed. Sorry, Elon. Siri, Meta's AI is great, and now it integrates with Facebook Ads Manager. Perplexity is great for deep research around complicated topics. Llama was actually decent, but Claude could disappear. You can use them both to prototype lead magnets. Meta AI, You try is decent, but not really useful. Open flow is helpful, but Claude co-worker can literally do the same thing. For a complete full list on the best AI tools to grow, comment the word list and I'll send them over to you.
